name: The Hundred Line - Goodbye Despair Route
source: A crossover fan-game prototype which brings the cast of The Hundred Line into Hope's Peak Academy, where they are suddenly transported to a tropical island by a talking bunny robot.
translation: 一款跨界同人游戏原型，将《百线》的演员带入希望之峰学院，在那里他们突然被一个会说话的兔子机器人传送到一个热带岛屿。
